title.en: An Act Converting the Sitio of Emilod, Municipality of Cuyo, Province of Palawan, into a Barrio of Said Municipality
title.orig: An Act Converting the Sitio of Emilod, Municipality of Cuyo, Province of Palawan, into a Barrio of Said Municipality
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Sitio Emilod tại Thị trấn Cuyo, Tỉnh Palawan thành Barrio của thị trấn nói trên
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะซิติโอ Emilod ในเทศบาล Cuyo จังหวัด Palawan เป็น บาริโอของเทศบาลดังกล่าว
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sitio Emilod di Kotamadya Cuyo, Provinsi Palawan menjadi Barrio dari kotamadya tersebut
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sitio Emilod di Perbandaran Cuyo, Wilayah Palawan kepada Barrio daripada perbandaran tersebut

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1750_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of Emilod, Municipality of Cuyo, Province of Palawan, is converted into a barrio of said municipality, to be known as the barrio of Emilod.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1957.
